profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987. Per its site, the company supports an ecosystem of global customers and partners with what it calls the industry's leading process technology and a portfolio of design enablement solutions. It also states that its business model accelerates innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications, and that it contributes to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy.

The company is a public for-profit corporation headquartered in Hsinchu, trading under the ticker TSM, and its SEC filing identifier is 0001046179. It is also listed under the alias Taiwan Semiconductor-SP ADR. No litigation, no AI products, and no MCP servers are recorded for it.
